```sql
SELECT d.region, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 2027 
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
GROUP BY d.region
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
```

```sql
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        o.order_date_local,
        o.net_revenue_eur,
        o.gross_revenue_eur,
        r.amount_eur
    FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN analytics.fct_refunds AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.order_date_local >= '2025-02-01'
      AND o.order_date_local < '2026-02-01'
),
refund_rate_by_country AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(r.amount_eur) AS total_refunded,
        SUM(o.gross_revenue_eur) AS total_gross_revenue,
        ROUND(SUM(r.amount_eur) * 1.0 / SUM(o.gross_revenue_eur), 4) AS refund_rate
    FROM order_revenue AS o
    JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 2026
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    region,
    refund_rate
FROM refund_rate_by_country
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT r.region, round(sum(r.amount_eur), 2) AS refunded
FROM analytics.fct_refunds AS r
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = r.refund_month
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 2026
```

```sql
SELECT round(avg(total_units), 2) AS average_units_per_order
FROM (
    SELECT o.order_id, sum(ol.quantity) AS total_units
    FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN analytics.fct_order_lines AS ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.order_date_local >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date_local < '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY o.order_id
) AS order_unit_summary
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(o.gross_revenue_eur - o.net_revenue_eur) AS gross_margin_eur
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.fct_order_lines AS l USING (order_id)
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date_local) = 2025;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    s.channel, 
    round(count(s.converted_order_id) * 100.0 / count(*), 4) AS share_of_sessions
FROM analytics.fct_sessions AS s
WHERE s.started_at >= '2025-01-01' AND s.started_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY s.channel
```

```sql
SELECT 
    m.channel,
    SUM(m.amount_eur) AS marketing_spend,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(m.amount_eur), 0), 0) AS roi
FROM raw.marketing_spend AS m
JOIN analytics.fct_orders AS o ON o.channel = m.channel
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE m.channel = 'paid_search'
    AND d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY m.channel
```

```sql
SELECT 
    d.day_name AS day_of_week,
    SUM(f.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS number_of_orders
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders f
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d 
    ON d.date_day = f.order_date_local
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND f.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    d.day_name
ORDER BY 
    d.day_name;
```

```sql
SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN analytics.fct_orders AS o USING (order_id)
JOIN analytics.dim_products AS p USING (product_id)
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date_local) = 2025
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue,
    CASE 
        WHEN d.calendar_year = 2024 THEN '2024'
        ELSE '2025'
    END AS year
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND d.calendar_year IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY o.region, d.calendar_year
ORDER BY o.region, year;
```
